description_zh: 调用该接口创建解析器
name: CreateParser

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The parser name. The name can contain Chinese characters, English letters, Japanese characters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must be 1 to 30 characters in length. A Chinese character or Japanese character counts as two characters
parameters.help_zh: 解析器名称，支持中文、英文字母、日文、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度为1~30个字符，一个中文及日文占2个字符
parameters.name: name
